thread:
incident-bot: Pager: latency-slo-breach detected for service=canary-rtc-v5 region=us-west-2 :rotating_light:

alex.garcia: I'm on it. Observing p99 jump to 12.3s across canary pool. p95 at ~1.8s up from 0.35s baseline.

marta.sre: Streaming stalls reported too — several requests stuck in 'waiting for kv' state. Logs show KV lock spikes around 12:34 UTC.

priya.ml: This started right after canary ramp to 20% traffic for v5. Rolling back to v4 lowered CPU but didn't fully recover tail yet.

sam.engineer: Can you share the prom query for p99? I want a raw timeline.

alex.garcia: prom: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, route))` — filter route='/v1/generate' and job=runtime

marta.sre: I ran the query: attached spike corresponds with a sudden rise in attention-kernel retries on host pool gpu-xc-*. Kernel logs show 'cuda mem pressure' warnings.

sam.engineer: That sounds like qkv kernel fallback. Did the model config use mixed-precision or fallback kernels? priya?

priya.ml: v5 uses the new fused-attn kernels + int8 quant profile. We tested offline but not under sustained long-context servo loads. Fallback to slower kernels if certain workspace alloc fails.

maya-support: Any customer-impact data? Customer-impact tag? We have 3 active premium customers routing canary traffic.

alex.garcia: Support: see trace ids for 11 distinct customer requests that saw >8s latency. One enterprise reported an app-level timeout at 10:47. I'll prepare a CVR.

tony-pm: We need a short customer brief. Are SLAs impacted? Which customers? Severity? Maya — coordinate.

maya-support: Noted. I'm DM'ing the three customers now: expecting replies in 15-30m. Telling them we're investigating a canary-induced latency issue and may roll back.

sam.engineer: Immediate mitigation: reduce canary traffic to 0% and route all canary tokens back to v4. Command: `/traffic shift service canary-rtc to v4 --percent=0 --strategy=instant`

deploy-bot: Executing traffic shift... 10/10 hosts drained, 0 failures

deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete. Route now pinned to v4 for Canary groups.

marta.sre: After the shift, p99 dropped from 12.3s -> 1.1s within 90s. Streaming stall counts went to near-zero. Looks like kernel fallback on v5 under certain batch patterns.

priya.ml: We're going to mark v5 as blocked for current quant profile. Need root cause: likely fused-attn memory accounting under long contexts + specific tokenization causing bigger KV cache.

alex.garcia: I'll open a rollback incident and tag for model-oncall + runtime team. Add labels: canary, quant, fused-attn, p99.

maya-support: Customers updated: 2 confirmed degraded, they've acknowledged rollback. One wants a follow-up postmortem and ETA for safer reruns.

tony-pm: OK. Next actions: 1) postmortem triage call in 30m 2) assign owners for kernel debug 3) communicate ETA to customers by EOD

sam.engineer: Quick triage notes: grab core dumps from gpu-xc-*, collect `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, and the serving runtime debug logs (level=trace) for the time window 12:30-12:50.

marta.sre: I've started collecting artifacts to /runs/2060728391-canary-latency. Sharing link: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/runs/2060728391

alex.garcia: Thanks. I'll post an incident summary for CS and legal. Tagging @priya.ml and @marta.sre for RCA.

priya.ml: Will create a repro harness against long context scenarios and test heavier KV sizes. Also adding a safety check to the rollout CI to throttle quant profile ramp when GPU mem estimates exceed threshold.

maya-support: Customers want a brief note when we have root cause. I'll hold final messages until postmortem.

tony-pm: Good work team. Move this to follow-up board and schedule an incident review. :thumbsup: 

alex.garcia: Closing the page for now, marking as in-progress -> mitigated. Will update thread with postmortem link.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> owner=alex.garcia

priya.ml: Assigning follow-ups: runtime#kernel-debug, qa#canary-test, infra#artifact-retention

sam.engineer: I'll check back in on kernel patches. If anyone needs me, ping.

marta.sre: Leaving notes in the incident tracker and setting priority to P2 now that customer impact is contained.

maya-support: Thanks all. I'll post the customer summary once we have RCA.

alex.garcia: Final note: do not re-run v5 on canary until we have a quant-safety gate. End.
